body:
The sleek Selenite Charging Plate from Energy Muse comes from Morocco, but Selenite can be found in many countries like Greece, Australia, the USA and Mexico. Before 2004, gypsum was thought to only exist on Earth. Then, it was confirmed that gypsum dune fields existed on the surface of Mars as well. Selenite’s power and influence goes beyond Earth’s atmosphere and out-of-this-world!

The pure, high vibrational energy of Selenite is like liquid light from the angelic realm, making it the best charging plate for crystals because it has the ability to cleanse, purify and align you with your highest potential. Low vibrational energies attract negativity on the same level, which is why your vibration is essential to keeping feelings of grief, fear, anger and anxiety out of your mental and physical space. If you've been doing a lot of work with crystals during times of stress or emotional turmoil, don't forget to release that toxic energy from them using the Selenite plate.

Selenite evokes protection from the celestial world, helping to dispel all negative energy from the body and mind. It is known to bring deep peace and mental clarity. When used as a charger and cleanser for other crystals, the Selenite Charging Plate will magnify the energy of anything that is placed upon it.

When you're drawn to a plate made of Selenite charging crystal, it's likely because either you or your crystals need a steady flow of cleansing and uplifting vibrations. Is the energy of your stone collection feeling dull? Do your stones not seem to vibrate with the same intensity as they used to? If so, it's time to purify their energy and get them charged up with a Selenite Charging Plate, an essential energy cleansing tool for every gemstone collection.

Our best-selling Selenite plate will get your stones back to vibrating at their full, healing potential. It's also possible your spirit is reaching out for Selenite because it needs those energizing vibes directed inward. Try setting a large Selenite charging plate on your desk at work or your windowsill at home so that you can see the light reflected off the stone; it's also a great way to keep your energy purified and uplifted all day long.
